parameters.name: Ipv6Address
parameters.description: One or more IPv6 addresses to delete. Valid values of N: 1 to 10.

parameters.name: Ipv6Prefix
parameters.description: One or more IPv6 prefixes to revoke. Valid values of N: 1 to 10.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID of the network interface controller (NIC). You can invoke [DescribeRegions](~~25609~~) to query the most recent region list.
